scope: Raw IFC parsing, geometry, project round trip and synthetic anomaly verification; browser tests are separate; no field validation.

tests.name: Raw IFC2x3 import preserves 236 objects, 21 rooms and semantic connections
Every raw-import room GUID, volume and dimensions agrees with offline geometry
Hallway volumes match BIM-declared 18.115464 m³ after winding correction
IFC4 millimeter model becomes a 4 × 3 × 2.5 meter room with 30 m³ volume
IFC without any renderable geometry gives an actionable error
Open mesh receives a visible approximate-volume basis
All seven scenarios return finite 121-frame solutions with small balance residuals
Exhaust loss and excess supply raise target pressure; supply loss lowers it
Increased reference leakage drives target negative pressure toward zero
Sensor bias preserves physical pressure but adds a separately measurable error
Door opening equalizes a genuine unequal-pressure connection
Recovery follows event and returns toward baseline
Unknown scenarios, invalid event times, missing door and bad target are rejected
Zero-severity physical scenarios match baseline exactly
Saved project can be revalidated and yields identical simulation
